cards.back:
A place where people buy and sell food and things.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasar
Example: Grandma buys vegetables at the market.
cards.say: market. A place where people buy and sell food and things. Grandma buys vegetables at the market.

cards.back:
A field where farmers grow rice.
Bahasa Indonesia: sawah
Example: The rice field is green and wide.
cards.say: rice field. A field where farmers grow rice. The rice field is green and wide.

cards.back:
The small grains that people in Indonesia cook and eat every day.
Bahasa Indonesia: beras atau nasi
Example: We eat rice for lunch.
cards.say: rice. The small grains that people in Indonesia cook and eat every day. We eat rice for lunch.

cards.back:
Cloth with beautiful patterns made with wax.
Bahasa Indonesia: batik
Example: My teacher wears batik on Friday.
cards.say: batik. Cloth with beautiful patterns made with wax. My teacher wears batik on Friday.

cards.back:
A three-wheeled vehicle that a person pedals to carry passengers.
Bahasa Indonesia: becak
Example: We ride a becak to the market.
cards.say: becak. A three-wheeled vehicle that a person pedals to carry passengers. We ride a becak to the market.

cards.back:
A small public minibus in Indonesia.
Bahasa Indonesia: angkot
Example: I go to school by angkot.
cards.say: angkot. A small public minibus in Indonesia. I go to school by angkot.

cards.back:
A long piece of cloth that people wrap round the waist.
Bahasa Indonesia: sarung
Example: Grandfather wears a sarong at home.
cards.say: sarong. A long piece of cloth that people wrap round the waist. Grandfather wears a sarong at home.

cards.back:
Traditional music played on metal instruments.
Bahasa Indonesia: gamelan
Example: We hear the gamelan at the festival.
cards.say: gamelan. Traditional music played on metal instruments. We hear the gamelan at the festival.

cards.back:
A traditional show with puppets and a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: wayang
Example: Wayang tells old stories.
cards.say: wayang. A traditional show with puppets and a story. Wayang tells old stories.

cards.back:
Small pieces of meat on a stick, cooked over fire.
Bahasa Indonesia: sate
Example: I eat chicken satay with sauce.
cards.say: satay. Small pieces of meat on a stick, cooked over fire. I eat chicken satay with sauce.

cards.back:
A food made from soya beans.
Bahasa Indonesia: tempe
Example: Fried tempeh is crispy.
cards.say: tempeh. A food made from soya beans. Fried tempeh is crispy.

cards.back:
Rice cooked with egg and vegetables in a pan.
Bahasa Indonesia: nasi goreng
Example: Fried rice is my favourite dinner.
cards.say: fried rice. Rice cooked with egg and vegetables in a pan. Fried rice is my favourite dinner.

cards.back:
A mountain that can throw out hot rock and smoke.
Bahasa Indonesia: gunung berapi
Example: Java has many volcanoes.
cards.say: volcano. A mountain that can throw out hot rock and smoke. Java has many volcanoes.

cards.back:
Land with water all around.
Bahasa Indonesia: pulau
Example: Indonesia has many islands.
cards.say: island. Land with water all around. Indonesia has many islands.

cards.back:
A small place in the countryside where people live.
Bahasa Indonesia: desa
Example: My grandparents live in a village.
cards.say: village. A small place in the countryside where people live. My grandparents live in a village.

cards.back:
A big green leaf that people use to wrap food.
Bahasa Indonesia: daun pisang
Example: The rice comes on a banana leaf.
cards.say: banana leaf. A big green leaf that people use to wrap food. The rice comes on a banana leaf.

cards.back:
A piece of cloth with the colours of a country. Indonesia's flag is red and white.
Bahasa Indonesia: bendera
Example: The flag is red and white.
cards.say: flag. A piece of cloth with the colours of a country. Indonesia's flag is red and white. The flag is red and white.

cards.back:
A building where Muslim people pray.
Bahasa Indonesia: masjid
Example: We hear the prayer call from the mosque.
cards.say: mosque. A building where Muslim people pray. We hear the prayer call from the mosque.

cards.back:
A building where some people go to pray, such as Hindus in Bali.
Bahasa Indonesia: pura atau candi
Example: We visit a temple in Bali.
cards.say: temple. A building where some people go to pray, such as Hindus in Bali. We visit a temple in Bali.

cards.back:
Following the old customs of a place or a people.
Bahasa Indonesia: tradisional
Example: She wears a traditional dress.
cards.say: traditional. Following the old customs of a place or a people. She wears a traditional dress.

cards.back:
A dark shape made when light is blocked.
Bahasa Indonesia: bayangan
Example: The puppet makes a shadow on the screen.
cards.say: shadow. A dark shape made when light is blocked. The puppet makes a shadow on the screen.
